description: This file contains the implementation of the ReminderTableGrain class, which manages reminder entries in Orleans runtime. It includes methods for reading, updating, and removing reminders, as well as migration support and logging.

classes.name: ReminderTableGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages reminder entries, supporting CRUD operations, migration, and logging.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic for the grain.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles deactivation logic for the grain.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table for testing purposes.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries for a specific grain or range.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder row for a grain.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder row based on grain, name, and eTag.
